name: Morningstar
description: The Morningstar connector makes it simple to power your AI apps and tools with Morningstar’s trusted content. It provides access to a growing library of AI-ready capabilities, including global analyst research, market analysis, and key investment data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Morningstar to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Morningstar to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.morningstar.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Morningstar MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Morningstar provides these MCP tools: morningstar-id-lookup-tool, morningstar-data-tool, morningstar-analyst-research-tool, morningstar-articles-tool, morningstar-screener-tool, and morningstar-fund-holdings-tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Morningstar?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Morningstar in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Morningstar requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Morningstar is developed by Morningstar. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
